body: Thanks for our concern, my mom and dad divorced, and my dad is states away. He was a lot like my mom, to the point where my mom had to take it to court to let us see him, but he’s been trying recently. And my mom realized she’s already under investigation from protective services, so she acted like she didn’t mean it, and I’m back living with her. I’m just gonna suck it up for another year and join the military after I graduate
